versions.changelog:
Initial release of ui-doctor — an auditing and repair skill for existing app UIs.

- Audits existing UIs for consistency, layout/state-sync bugs, responsiveness, accessibility, and performance issues.
- Special focus on message/chat UI correctness, including markdown, table, and code block rendering.
- Always verifies installed library versions against official, current documentation before diagnosing or applying fixes.
- Prioritizes root-cause fixes, with evidence-based verification and concrete reporting of changes.
- Follows project’s design-system-architect outputs (if present) for audit standards; otherwise defaults to industry best practices.
- Activated upon reports of visual inconsistencies, broken layouts, sync issues, or when a UI audit/review is requested.
